+def test_nodal_force_geometry_witness_reused_only_at_exact_pose(monkeypatch):
+    model, definition, settings, _program = build_case(
+        4, load_profile="distributed", total_force_n=0.3,
+        target_right_x_m=1.3,
+    )
+    manager = GeneralS3PatchManager(model, definition, settings)
+    law = manager.law
+    pose = np.zeros(model.mesh.dof_manager.total_dofs)
+    forces = 0.3*reference_nodal_support(law)
+    law._nodal_geometry_cache = None
+    reference_residual = linearize(manager, pose, forces, tangent=False)
+    law._nodal_geometry_cache = None
+    reference_tangent = linearize(manager, pose, forces, tangent=True)
+
+    calls = 0
+    original_evaluate = law.geometry.evaluate
+
+    def counted_evaluate(source, target):
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        return original_evaluate(source, target)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(law.geometry, "evaluate", counted_evaluate)
+    law._nodal_geometry_cache = None
+    residual = linearize(manager, pose.copy(), forces, tangent=False)
+    tangent = linearize(manager, pose.copy(), forces, tangent=True)
+    assert calls == 1
+    for observed, expected in ((residual, reference_residual),
+                               (tangent, reference_tangent)):
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed.force, expected.force)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed.gap_gradient,
+                                      expected.gap_gradient)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed.state.reference_support,
+                                      expected.state.reference_support)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed.state.reference_weighted_gap,
+                                      expected.state.reference_weighted_gap)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(observed.state.pressure_gram,
+                                      expected.state.pressure_gram)
+        assert observed.state.overlap_signature == expected.state.overlap_signature
+        assert observed.state.integration_triangles == expected.state.integration_triangles
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(tangent.tangent.toarray(),
+                                  reference_tangent.tangent.toarray())
+
+    moved = pose.copy()
+    moved[model.mesh.dof_manager.get_node_dofs(3)[2]] += 1.0e-7
+    first = linearize(manager, moved, forces, tangent=False)
+    assert calls == 2
+    second = linearize(manager, moved.copy(), 0.5*forces, tangent=False)
+    assert calls == 2
+    assert np.linalg.norm(first.force-second.force) > 0.0
+
